<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def eye_pos():
    L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if L[rr][cc]=='S']
    if not sc: return None
    rs=sorted(set(x[0] for x in sc)); cs=sorted(set(x[1] for x in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs), min(left), max(right))

print("start:", eye_pos())
for act in ['UP','UP']:
    r=action([act], intent='explore')
    res=last_action_result
    ep=eye_pos()
    print(f"{act} -> step{current_frame.step} eyes{ep} no_impact={res.get('no_impact')} level_completed={res.get('level_completed')} done={res.get('done')} game_over={res.get('game_over')}")
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete'):
        print("TERMINAL!"); break
    if res.get('no_impact'):
        print("blocked, stopping"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
